relations.text: Nebiusが年次報告で、NVIDIAやOEMとの強い関係が最新GPUの提供を支えると記載
relations.text_en: Nebius says its strong relationships with NVIDIA and OEM partners support providing the latest GPUs (annual report)

source.label: Nebius 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Our strong relationships with NVIDIA and OEM partners support our ability to consistently provide the latest and most advanced GPU technology available in the marketplace.

relations.text: NVIDIAがNebiusに20億ドルを出資する戦略的提携(2026年3月11日、6-K)
relations.text_en: NVIDIA and Nebius announced a strategic partnership under which NVIDIA will invest $2B in Nebius (March 11, 2026, 6-K)

source.label: Nebius 6-K Ex. 99.1(NVIDIA/Nebius joint の発表, 2026-03-11)
source.quote: NVIDIA will invest $2 billion in Nebius
source.note: 6-Kでは、出資は事前に払い込む形の新株予約権とされています。
source.note_en: Per the 6-K, the investment is a pre-funded warrant.

relations.text: AIインフラ向けに、送電網を介さない電源としてBloomの燃料電池を導入する契約(2026年5月20日)
relations.text_en: Agreement to deploy Bloom fuel cells for behind-the-meter power for Nebius’s AI infrastructure (May 20, 2026)

source.label: Nebius ニュースルーム の発表(2026-05-20)
source.quote: Bloom's fuel cell systems will provide behind-the-meter electricity for Nebius
source.note: 最初の328MWは稼働予定で、稼働済みではありません。
source.note_en: The first 328MW is expected, not yet operating.

relations.text: ニュージャージー州Vinelandのデータセンターで、専用GPU基盤を5年間Microsoftに提供(年次報告)
relations.text_en: Provides Microsoft dedicated GPU capacity at its Vineland, New Jersey data center over five years (annual report)

source.label: Nebius 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: we are providing Microsoft access to dedicated GPU infrastructure capacity in clusters at our new data center in Vineland, New Jersey over a five-year term
source.note: 契約額は最大約174億ドルと見積もられ、導入状況などに左右されます。
source.note_en: Contract value estimated at up to about $17.4B, subject to deployment and other conditions.

relations.text: 専用GPU容量の発注に関するインフラサービス契約をMetaと締結(2026年3月、年次報告)
relations.text_en: Infrastructure Services Agreement with Meta for dedicated GPU capacity orders (March 2026, annual report)

source.label: Nebius 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: entered into an Infrastructure Services Agreement with Meta Platforms, Inc. ("Meta"), pursuant to which we and Meta will enter into a series of orders
source.note: 最初の発注分を含む契約総額は最大約270億ドルと見積もられています。
source.note_en: Total contract value including initial orders is estimated at up to about $27B.

relations.text: PalantirがNebiusを推奨するソブリンAI基盤パートナーに指定(2026年9月8日、6-K)
relations.text_en: Palantir named Nebius its preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner (September 8, 2026, 6-K)

source.label: Nebius 6-K Ex. 99.1(Palantir/Nebius joint の発表, 2026-09-08)
source.quote: Palantir has named Nebius its preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner

relations.text: UberとNebiusが、自動運転子会社Avrideに最大3.75億ドルを共同出資(2025年10月22日、年次報告)
relations.text_en: Uber and Nebius jointly invested up to $375M in Nebius’s autonomous-driving subsidiary Avride (October 22, 2025, annual report)

source.label: Nebius 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: In October 2025, Uber participated alongside us in an investment of up to $375 million into Avride.
source.note: 関係はNebiusの子会社Avrideを通じたものです。
source.note_en: The relationship is at the Avride (Nebius subsidiary) level.

source.label: Nebius 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: our key competitors are specialized cloud service providers focused on AI, including CoreWeave, Crusoe and Lambda

relations.text: Nebiusが年次報告で、汎用クラウドの競合としてOracleを挙げている

source.label: Nebius 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: We also compete with general purpose cloud computing providers including Amazon (AWS), Google (Google Cloud Platform), Microsoft (Azure), and Oracle.

source.quote: We also compete with general purpose cloud computing providers including Amazon (AWS), Google (Google Cloud Platform), Microsoft (Azure), and Oracle.

source.quote: specialized AI Cloud Services providers, including CoreWeave, Nebius, Crusoe, Lambda, Nscale, SpaceX and others

relations.text: WhiteFiberが年次報告で、主な競合としてNebiusを挙げている
relations.text_en: WhiteFiber’s annual report names Nebius among its primary competitors

source.label: WhiteFiber 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitors in the cloud service business are CoreWeave, Crusoe Energy, Nebius, and Lambda Labs.
